description: This file defines the ClientEnumerations class which provides static methods for converting client-related enumerations (such as status, legal form, transaction type) to EnumOptionData objects. It acts as a utility class for handling client enumeration values within the project.

classes.name: ClientEnumerations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to convert various client enumeration values into EnumOptionData objects.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Converts an Integer or ClientStatus to an EnumOptionData representing the client's status.

methods.name: legalForm
methods.description: Converts an Integer or LegalForm to an EnumOptionData representing the legal form.

methods.name: clientTransactionType
methods.description: Converts an int or ClientTransactionType to an EnumOptionData representing the transaction type.
